description: Upright full-length figure with complete hair, hands and feet visible. Cream fine linen beneath long plum-purple tailored outer coat and diagonal shoulder drape, narrow gold woven borders at neckline/cuffs/edges, round shoulder clasp and decorated brown belt with worked gold discs and hanging end, brown leather boots. Plain blurred stone doorway, no banner, headgear, armor or weapon. Clean-shaven young adult medium physique.
